title: Stopping at a dyadic grid point selects the increments ending there or earlier
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Stopping at a dyadic grid point selects the increments ending there or earlier. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Fix a positive time horizon T, a coarse level m and a fine level n at least m. Choose a coarse grid point τ. For any two real paths X and Y on nonnegative time, the fine-grid sum of products of their stopped increments equals the fine-grid prefix sum of their original increment products through τ.
